verdict.rationale: Clara documents a REST API giving programmatic control over cards, transactions, users and invoices. It backs this with an OpenAPI 3.1 schema (probe-verified), self-serve API credentials from the dashboard, and runnable code examples. An isolated sandbox for end-to-end testing makes unattended, non-interactive automation pipelines practical, so headless operation is the product's own documented capability. On the reviewer concern: the evidence supports this full/7 rating, and nothing in the pack contradicts or weakens it. Missing for 10: no official CLI or CI-specific guidance (e.g., pipeline or service-account examples), and no independent or hands-on corroboration of headless/CI use.
